# OpenDLE: Studio workspace instructions

## GitHub publication

- Do not push commits, branches, tags or other updates to GitHub unless the user
  explicitly requests that push.
- Permission for an earlier push does not authorize future pushes. Completing
  implementation, testing or documentation changes is not permission to publish.

## Documentation

- Keep README.md short and user-facing, with honest feature and licensing claims.
- Keep detailed internal/development documentation in DEVELOPMENT.md.
